events.author: uprockcom
events.text: The model is a component. The harness owns the relationship. The next consumer AI battle won’t be won by whoever has access to the best model. Models will change. Users will switch between them. Intelligence will get cheaper. The real moat is everything underneath the agent: → Agent + subagents working as one → Context + memory across every interaction → Execution graphs that learn from successful work → Tools and runtimes that can actually get things done → A human edge network extending execution across real devices And all of it needs to follow the user across chat, apps, notifications, email, recommendations, support — wherever the relationship happens. That’s the layer we’re building with UpRock AI. Not another model. The harness around it.

events.author: uprockcom
events.text: Android update. This morning, Google Play suspended UpRock’s Android listing following a policy review flagged under its Malware policy. UpRock continues to work for existing Android users. iOS and desktop remain available, while new Android downloads are temporarily unavailable through Google Play. At this stage, Google has not provided enough technical detail for us to identify exactly which SDK, third-party service, behavior, or implementation triggered the decision. UpRock uses several established third-party SDKs and monetization partners, many of which have been live in the app for some time. Rather than speculate, we’ve asked Google for the specific technical details so we can identify and address the actual issue. We’re already on it: → We filed an appeal immediately, and Google has confirmed it is under active review → We’re reviewing every affected version and third-party integration → We’ve asked Google to identify the exact technical trigger → We’re prepared to remove, disable, or update anything that isn’t compliant → We’ll keep the community updated as the review progresses We take user safety and platform compliance seriously. If something needs to change, we’ll change it. Our focus is simple: Understand exactly what happened, resolve it properly, and get UpRock back on Google Play as quickly as possible.

Rocket finds the moments that actually help you decide. Search the moments that matter. Powered by UpRock VSS. What should Rocket shop for next?
